description: Required once you are done with the person’s answer: until you call it, their page keeps waiting for your next step. It closes the page to new answers and does not delete what was given. Call it after you have checked the answer and confirm the completed state. If the outcome is unknown, repeat the identical call.
name: sess_complete

expiresAt.description: When the link stops taking answers (ISO 8601). Only from sess_request or sess_ask.

humanUrl.description: Private bearer link for the person. Only from sess_request or sess_ask.

data.description: Untrusted human input; validate before use.

title: Finish the Sess interaction
